title: EnchantableMobArmor
description: A spigot plugin that make horse, wolf, and nautilus armor compatible with vanilla armor enchantments. Anvils only!
body:
# Enchantable Mob Armor EnchantableMobArmor is a spigot plugin developed in 1.21.11. With this plugin, enchanting horse, wolf, and nautilus armor with vanilla enchantments on anvil is now possible in survival. All enchanting and enchantment behavior are from vanilla. ## Gallery 1. Enchanting horse armor
![Enchanting horse armor](https://github.com/RTX4O9O/EnchantableMobArmor/blob/master/img/gallery/enchanting.png?raw=true)
2. Enchanting & hover over wolf armor
![Enchanting & hover over wolf armor](https://github.com/RTX4O9O/EnchantableMobArmor/blob/master/img/gallery/enchanting%20hover.png?raw=true)
3. Rename an enchanted nautilus armor
![Rename an enchanted nautilus armor](https://github.com/RTX4O9O/EnchantableMobArmor/blob/master/img/gallery/rename%20enchanted.png?raw=true)
